intro.text: Don't ask how I know this, and don't put it in writing. There is something under {place} you need to see, and it will only make sense standing over it. Meet me there, {date}. Come alone. An hour.
intro.missedText: You weren't at {place}. I can't keep going down there by myself, and I can't explain it here. Again: {date}, same place. Be there.

lines: *Vespera is waiting by the hot pool in a long dark coat, her hat pulled low. She checks the doorway behind you twice before she smiles.*
Vespera: You came. Good. Don't look so worried, sugar. Nobody gets expelled for taking a bath.
*She leads you round behind the steaming pool to a narrow door you have never noticed. Behind it, an old stair goes down into the dark.*
Vespera: This University was built on top of something. Drains, root cellars, a gallery where the first masons cut their wards, and at the very bottom, the spring the Bloom rises from.
Vespera: Seven hundred years of ward-lines are anchored down there. They hold up the wards over every hall you've ever slept in. And they're slipping.
Vespera: Where a line slips, raw Bloom pools and takes a shape. Slimes with no mind in them. Roots that grab. Old wards that came loose and started walking. Nothing like Lira, before you ask.
Vespera: They will knock you flat if you let them. Go down unready and you come back up with bruises and nothing in your pockets.
Vespera: Now the part you'll like. The Bloom settles around a True Sire. An anchor will only take under your hands. Not mine, not the Board's. Yours.
Vespera: You have no magic, so you can't go alone. You take women who do, two at a time, ones who trust you enough to follow you into the dark.
Vespera: And a woman carrying your child is a great deal stronger down there. Make of that what you will.
Vespera: Why bother? Because if the wards go, the University goes with them. And because there is always something lying by an anchor: money, strange old things, and relics.

Vespera: The relics are the real prize, sugar. Each one is old magic with a will of its own, and no two do the same thing. Some change how every woman in this place behaves around you. Some do things in a moment that I would not say out loud in a chapel.
Vespera: The women who go down with you remember it, too. Nothing brings two people closer than a fight in a sewer.
Vespera: One more thing. Touching the ward-lines without the Arcane Board's leave is illegal. I've been doing it alone, and quietly. Keep it that way.
Vespera: Now. Let me show you how it works, before you go and get yourself eaten.

enemies.name: Wild slime
enemies.appearance: A waist-high shapeless blob of translucent green living water, glistening, with a brighter glowing core and no face or limbs. It drips and leaves a wet trail.

enemies.name: Root tangle
enemies.appearance: A walking knot of pale writhing tree roots, hunched on four thick root legs, thorny, with small glowing violet buds along its limbs and no face.

enemies.name: Pipe wight
enemies.appearance: A hunched humanoid shape assembled from rusted copper pipes, elbows and valve wheels, steam venting from its joints, furnace-orange light glowing from inside its ribcage of pipes. No face, only a round pressure gauge for a head.

enemies.name: Loose ward
enemies.appearance: A floating construct of magic with no body: broken concentric rings of glowing blue runes turning inside one another, with jagged shards of blue light orbiting and trailing sparks.

enemies.name: Steam shade
enemies.appearance: A tall thin wisp of white steam in the vague shape of a hooded robed figure, its lower half trailing away into vapor, with two small ember-orange points for eyes.

enemies.name: The Drowned Valve
enemies.appearance: A huge corroded iron valve wheel, crusted with limescale and river weed, risen on a thick twisting column of dark water. Two arms of bent lead pipe hang from it, pouring water. Green light glows behind the spokes of the wheel.

enemies.name: The Root Mother
enemies.appearance: A massive bulb of roots like an upturned tree stump as tall as a doorway, with many heavy root limbs spread wide, a hollow in its center holding a glowing violet heart, and seed pods hanging from it like lanterns.

enemies.name: The Broken Lattice
enemies.appearance: A large fractured lattice of glowing blue ward-lines, like a shattered stained-glass window hanging upright in the air, its panes missing, jagged shards circling it and crackling with light.

enemies.name: The Boiler Saint
enemies.appearance: A towering figure formed by an upright copper boiler, its riveted plates hanging like a robe, a furnace door for a chest blazing orange, short heavy pipe arms, and a halo of brass pipes fanned behind where a head would be.

enemies.name: The Chained Stack
enemies.appearance: An animated toppled bookcase reared upright, bound round and round with iron chains, its books flapping open like wings and loose pages swirling about it, violet light glowing between the shelves.

enemies.name: The Stillwater
enemies.appearance: A tall smooth faceless figure made of perfectly still black water with a mirror surface, standing on a disc of the same water, edged in pale blue light, featureless and symmetrical.

enemies.name: The First Ward
enemies.appearance: A giant ancient stone ring standing upright like a wheel, carved all round with deep runes, golden light filling its center, with broken blocks of masonry orbiting slowly around it.

enemies.name: The Wellspring
enemies.appearance: A colossal fountain of luminous green-gold water rising into a crowned, vaguely feminine shape woven from water, roots and light, with no face, arms spread wide, mist pouring from it.

depths.name: the Old Drains
depths.appearance: A vaulted brick storm drain under an old bathhouse. Ankle-deep warm water steams along the floor between mossy stone walkways. Rusted iron grates, dripping copper pipes along the walls, limescale. A pale green glow pools in the water and lights the brick arches from below.

relic.name: Silver Tongue
relic.description: A charm on a fine chain that loosens every woman's tongue. While it is on, they all talk dirty.
relic.appearance: A small silver charm shaped like a curled tongue, hanging from a fine silver chain, polished and gleaming.

depths.name: the Root Cellars
depths.appearance: Low stone cellars broken through by enormous pale tree roots that hang from the ceiling and coil across an earth floor. Sagging shelves of forgotten dusty jars. The roots glow faintly violet where they have split the masonry. Dark, close, damp.

relic.name: Exhibitionist's Lantern
relic.description: A lantern whose rose light makes being seen feel wonderful. While it is on, every woman likes to be watched.
relic.appearance: A small ornate brass lantern with panes of rose-tinted glass, a warm pink flame glowing inside.

depths.name: the Ward Gallery
depths.appearance: A long underground stone gallery with a barrel vault and heavy pillars. The walls are carved with great concentric circles and bands of runes that glow blue; some are cracked and flicker, leaking light like mist. Loose flagstones, drifting motes of blue light.

relic.name: Apple of Discord
relic.description: A golden apple with one bite gone. While it is on, jealousy runs hot: twice the drama, twice the interruptions.
relic.appearance: A shining golden apple with a single bite taken out of it, the bitten flesh glowing faintly.

depths.name: the Boiler Vaults
depths.appearance: A vast vaulted chamber around a colossal riveted copper boiler, green with age. Brass pipes as thick as tree trunks, valve wheels, gauges, catwalks of iron grating. Steam hangs in the air, lit orange by a furnace glow from the boiler seams.

relic.name: The Unraveling
relic.description: A spool of shimmering thread. Used in a scene, every stitch of clothing on everyone there vanishes at once.
relic.appearance: A small wooden spool of shimmering silver thread, the loose end unwinding itself into the air in glittering coils.

depths.name: the Chained Stacks
depths.appearance: A buried library hall far underground. Towering dark bookshelves lean into the gloom, every book bound shut with small chains, longer chains hanging slack from the ceiling. Thick dust, fallen ladders, a single cold violet lantern glow between the stacks.

nodes.name: Shelves that should not be here
What the books were chained for

relic.name: Hourglass of Stillness
relic.description: An hourglass whose sand hangs still. Used in a scene, time stops for everyone but you and those you are with.
relic.appearance: A small brass hourglass whose golden sand hangs motionless in the middle of its fall, frozen in the glass.

depths.name: the Still Pools
depths.appearance: A natural limestone cavern of perfectly still black pools like mirrors, joined by worn stepping stones. Stalactites and their exact reflections. Pale blue bioluminescence along the waterline. Utterly calm, no ripples, deep shadows.

nodes.name: An offering left on a ledge

relic.name: Sapphic Charm
relic.description: Two crescent moons locked together. Used in a scene, the women there are drawn to each other and want to kiss.
relic.appearance: A pendant of two interlocking crescent moons carved from pale rose quartz, on a thin gold chain.

depths.name: the First Foundations
depths.appearance: The oldest masonry under the University: cyclopean rough-hewn stone blocks fitted without mortar, carved with masons marks. A great ward-ring is cut into the floor of a round chamber and filled with dim gold light. Broken tools, stone dust, immense weight overhead.

relic.name: Mind's Eye
relic.description: A violet crystal eye. Used in a scene, you hear what the women there are really thinking.
relic.appearance: A glass eye of deep violet crystal with a golden iris, glowing softly from within.

depths.name: the Wellspring
depths.appearance: A cathedral-sized cavern at the bottom of everything. A hot spring wells up in a wide stone basin, glowing green-gold and throwing light up through rising mist. Giant roots and ancient copper pipes converge on it from every side. At its center stands a weathered stone anchor pillar carved with runes.

relic.name: Seed of the First Bloom
relic.description: The seed the University was built to keep. Used in a scene, whatever the women there take against the Bloom does nothing.
relic.appearance: A large golden seed glowing warmly from within, with a single green sprout curling from its tip.
